verdict.rationale: Disputes are a fair question for a payments and e-commerce platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows dispute handling through the API or MCP. The documented REST API covers products, sales, subscribers and licenses. The MCP surface lets an agent list sales, edit and publish products, and check payouts. Neither mentions retrieving disputes, assembling evidence or submitting responses.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API
